ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels and 30% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous high-intensity white zones occupy the medial and lateral portions of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is concentrated at the median notch, along the entire trailing edge, at the distal tips, and along the peduncle attachment area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal plane of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels. The right lobe trailing edge displays significantly more pronounced jagged peaks than the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a concave upward sweep ending in tapered distal tips, with a predominantly convex trailing edge profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several localized clusters of small, low-intensity circular spots are visible on the inner-white region of the left lobe and near the trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct sets of parallel, low-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) are detected; one set is oriented diagonally on the left lobe, and multiple sets are oriented horizontally across the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the high-intensity regions of both lobes and irregular scarring/missing tissue along the trailing edges indicative of physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, dark, vertically-oriented elongated mark is present in the center of the left lobe's high-intensity zone.
